title: TheJacksonLaboratory/5baseTAPS pipeline parameters
description: JAX Genomic Technologies 5-base TAPS methylation and variant calling pipeline

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: Create a samplesheet CSV with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. It must be a comma-separated file with a header row. See docs/usage.md for the samplesheet format.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

main_options.title: Main options
main_options.description: Most common options used for the pipeline

mode.description: The pipeline mode to use, either 'rd' for R&D or 'ht' for High-Throughput

duplex_seq.description: Enable when the input is duplex sequenecing.
duplex_seq.help_text: With this parameter flags in various tools are set for duplex sequencing data.

align_raw_bam_chunks.description: Split FASTQ into N chunks for parallel alignment then merge. 1 = disabled (original path). 4 recommended for 500M+ reads.

run_gatk.description: Run GATK variant calling workflow. Set to false to skip (methylation-only runs).

rastair_rscript_dir.description: Path to directory containing rastair R scripts (mbias.R, QC_report_jax.Rmd, perChr_mbias_chr.R, render_allChr_mbias.R, allChr_mbias_report_jax.Rmd). Defaults to bin/rastair_scripts/ inside the pipeline. Use empty string to use container built-ins.

plot_vbias.description: Enable per-fragment V-bias heatmap in the M-bias report. Adds ~10 GB and ~3 min per chromosome to MBIAS_PER_CHR.

plot_gc.description: Enable GC/CpG/depth bias plots in the M-bias report. Requires the reference FASTA and the rastair call VCF.

rastair_mbias_mem_base.description: Base memory (GB) for RASTAIR_MBIAS on attempt 1. Scaled up by rastair_mbias_mem_step on each retry.

rastair_mbias_mem_step.description: Memory increment (GB) added per retry attempt for RASTAIR_MBIAS.

grouping.title: Read grouping options
grouping.description: Options for when grouping reads by UMI

groupreadsbyumi_strategy.help_text: Grouping strategy for fgbio's GroupReadsByUmi. (options: Identity, Edit, Adjacency, Paired, Default). Using an empty string will default to 'Paired' for duplex sequencing data, and 'Adjacency' otherwise.

groupreadsbyumi_edits.help_text: Maximum number of allowable edits for fgbio's GroupReadsByUmi.

consensus_calling.title: Consensus reads options
consensus_calling.description: Options for when creating consensus reads

call_min_reads.description: Minimum reads to call a consensus
call_min_reads.help_text: The minimum reads to call a consensus for fgbio's CallMolecularConsensusReads/CallDuplexConsensusReads.

call_min_baseq.help_text: The minimum input base quality to use when calling a consensus for fgbio's CallMolecularConsensusReads/CallDuplexConsensusReads.

consensus_filtering.title: Consensus filtering options
consensus_filtering.description: Options for when filtering consensus reads

filter_min_reads.description: Minimum reads to keep a consensus
filter_min_reads.help_text: The minimum reads to keep a consensus for fgbio's FilterConsensusReads.

filter_min_baseq.help_text: The minimum consensus base quality to keep when calling a consensus for fgbio's FilterConsensusReads.

filter_max_base_error_rate.description: The maximum error rate for a single consensus base
filter_max_base_error_rate.help_text: The maximum error rate for a single consensus base when filtering a consensus for fgbio's FilterConsensusReads.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome related files and options required for the workflow.

genome.help_text: If using a reference genome configured in the pipeline, use this parameter to give the ID for the reference (e.g. `--genome CHM13` or `--genome GRCh38`). This is used to build full paths to all required reference genome files defined in conf/genomes_elion.config.

fasta.help_text: This parameter is *mandatory* if `--genome` is not specified. If you don't have a BWA index available this will be generated for you automatically. Combine with `--save_reference` to save BWA index for future runs.

dict.help_text:
If you use AWS iGenomes, this has already been set for you appropriately.

> **NB** If none provided, will be generated automatically from the FASTA reference. Combine with `--save_reference` to save for future runs.

fasta_fai.help_text:
If you use AWS iGenomes, this has already been set for you appropriately.

> **NB** If none provided, will be generated automatically from the FASTA reference. Combine with `--save_reference` to save for future runs.

bwamem2.description: Path to pre-built bwa-mem2 index directory.
bwamem2.help_text:
If you use AWS iGenomes or have a pre-built bwa-mem2 index, provide the directory path here.

> **NB** If none provided, will be generated automatically from the FASTA reference. Combine with `--save_reference` to save for future runs.

igenomes_ignore.description: Do not load the iGenomes reference config.
igenomes_ignore.help_text: Do not load `igenomes.config` when running the pipeline. You may choose this option if you observe clashes between custom parameters and those supplied in `igenomes.config`.

save_reference.description: If generated by the pipeline save the STAR index in the results directory.
save_reference.help_text: If an alignment index is generated by the pipeline use this parameter to save it to your results folder. These can then be used for future pipeline runs, reducing processing times.

igenomes_base.description: The base path to the igenomes reference files

lambda_fasta.description: Path to lambda phage FASTA file (negative control spike-in). If set, runs the lambda genome methylation QC subworkflow.

lambda_fai.description: Path to lambda phage FASTA index (.fai).

lambda_dict.description: Path to lambda phage sequence dictionary (.dict).

lambda_bwamem2.description: Path to pre-built bwa-mem2 index directory for lambda phage.

puc19_fasta.description: Path to pUC19 FASTA file (positive control spike-in). If set, runs the pUC19 genome methylation QC subworkflow.

puc19_bwamem2.description: Path to pre-built bwa-mem2 index directory for pUC19.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: Configuration profile parameters used to describe the compute environment. This information is printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: Base URL or local path to a directory of institutional Nextflow config files. Leave empty (the default) to skip fetching external institutional configs.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options allow you to customise core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

hook_url.description: Incoming hook URL for messaging service
hook_url.help_text: Incoming hook URL for messaging service. Currently, MS Teams and Slack are supported.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

multiqc_replace_names.description: Two-column sample renaming TSV file passed to MultiQC. First column a set of patterns, second column a set of corresponding replacements.

multiqc_sample_names.description: TSV file with headers passed to MultiQC.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.
